settings.title: White Glove Outdoor & Exterior Care · North Carolina & Virginia

settings.editor: From land clearing and site development to tree care and ongoing property upkeep, one team handles the entire scope of your property. One call. One standard.

settings.title: One property. One call. The whole job done right.

settings.editor: Most outdoor projects mean calling a grading contractor, a tree service, a landscaper and a handyman, then spending weeks coordinating all four. Magnolia Property Care was built to remove that burden. We handle the full scope under one contract, one schedule and one standard of care.
Whether you are developing a new homesite, restoring an overgrown property or simply want someone dependable to look after a second home, you deal with one person who knows your property.

settings.editor: Forestry mulching, land clearing, grading, drainage, retaining walls, hardscaping, gravel driveways and more. Raw land to finished grounds.
Removal, pruning, storm cleanup and brush removal.

settings.title: For Second Home Owners & Property Managers

settings.editor: Scheduled visits, seasonal upkeep and handyman repairs from one trusted contact, so your property is ready whenever you are.
Forestry mulching, land clearing, rough and finish grading, culvert and gravel drive installation.
French drain system, segmental retaining wall, regrading and sod installation.
Selective tree removal for a water view, brush removal, stump grinding and hydroseeding.

Magnolia Property Care is owned and operated by Heys McMath, who left a ten-year career in logistics and financial services to build the outdoor company he always wanted to run. That background shows up in how we work: clear communication, tight scheduling and a finished product you will be proud of. We are fully licensed and insured and can provide a certificate of insurance on request.
Tell us about your property and we will schedule a site visit and estimate.
